subject: Compact pilot snapshot and quick endorsement invite
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@shopable.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@shopable.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Compact pilot snapshot and quick endorsement invite

Hi Lina / Evan,

Thanks again for running the 6-week pilot with Redwood. We ran a short internal wrap-up and wanted to share the headline numbers and a small request — would Shopable be willing to share a two‑line quote and join a 15‑minute call for a potential case study? If so we’ll keep the ask very light.

Headlines (pilot window: Aug 10 — Sep 18):
- Average inference latency (p95): 120ms (baseline internal target: 160ms)
- Token cost reduction vs. prior system: 36%
- Query throughput sustained: 4.2k QPS across two dedicated nodes
- Classification accuracy (NLU intent): 92.4% on the validation set used in the pilot
- Estimated monthly cost saving at current volume: ~$12k

Attached is a one‑page metrics brief (pilot_metrics_summary_MK_v1.pdf) and a short list of suggested quote options (recommended-quote-options.txt). Proposed next steps:
1) If you’re open, could you provide a two‑line quote we could use in marketing (we can draft it for approval)?
2) If okay, 15 minutes to capture a quick on‑record line and confirm attribution — we’re flexible with timing.

Appreciate the partnership — grateful for the clear signal the pilot gave on cost and latency.

If it helps, Marissa will own the case study logistics and Dev can jump in on any technical questions.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
